in_sanskrit.name: Rambalak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Thunder
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rambalak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ram meaning God and Balak meaning a boy or child, so the name Rambalak means 'God of Thunder' or 'God of Boys'. This name is derived from Hindu mythology and is associated with the god Indra, the god of rain and thunder.
